questions.question: The Supreme Court recently ordered the implementation of automatic challans for which type of vehicles, using cameras?
questions.explanation: The Supreme Court recently issued an order for the implementation of automatic challans for uninsured vehicles, utilizing cameras for detection. This initiative aims to ensure compliance with motor insurance regulations and enhance road safety.
questions.background: Motor vehicle insurance is mandatory in India to provide financial protection against accidents. questions.question: Which regulatory body recently issued prohibition-of-sale orders against certain liquor makers and banned '100% pure' claims on Dabur products for being ambiguous and misleading?
options: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
questions.explanation: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) recently issued prohibition-of-sale orders against several liquor makers, stating that some rum and whisky brands were wrongly labeled as aged. Concurrently, FSSAI also banned '100% pure' claims on Dabur products, citing them as ambiguous, unverifiable, and likely to mislead consumers.
questions.background: FSSAI is India's apex food regulator, responsible for protecting and promoting public health through the regulation and supervision of food safety. Its actions against misleading labels and improper product descriptions are crucial for consumer protection and fair trade practices in the food and beverage industry.
